facts.label: English
facts.value: The Village of Apricot Blossoms (the Springtime Lodge of Apricot Blossoms)

facts.label: Built
facts.value: 康熙年间 初名菜圃 (S42)

facts.label: Changed
facts.value: 1755 春雨轩 and 涧壑余清 built over the vegetable beds (S41); Malone p.80 n.: official map shows a lake and more buildings.

facts.label: Destroyed
facts.value: 1860; 杏花春馆 and 春雨轩 on the 1873 survival list (S06)

facts.label: 日下旧闻考
facts.value: 上下天光之西折而南度橋為杏花春館 [j81:1a]

facts.label: Note
facts.value: Album does not show the 1860 state here (S41).
